description: This file defines the ServiceContainer class, which implements a singleton pattern for managing an instance of ContainerBuilder within the OrangeHRM framework. It provides static methods to access or create the singleton instance and retrieve the container builder.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: Implements a singleton pattern to manage a single instance of ContainerBuilder, providing static access to the container.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ServiceContainer, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Returns the singleton ContainerBuilder instance, initializing the ServiceContainer if necessary.
